text:
Sara (Sales): New RFP from Cortica — they need private deployment, HSM-backed KMS, EU data residency, and a capability matrix + tiered pricing. They want a 2-week POC with perf targets: 120 QPS embeddings, 40 QPS chat; latency P95 <120ms.

Priya (Cortica): Correct — also need audit log exports to their SIEM, and pen-test report. We'll share sample prompt sets.

Liam (Solutions): Proposed POC scope: 1) Private cluster in eu-west-1 with VPC peering 2) HSM sim for BYOK test 3) Perf runs at 50/120/200 QPS 4) Quality evals on their prompts. Est. prep 7 days + 5 day run.

Rebecca (Security): I'll fill RFI sections for KMS/HSM, key rotation, access controls. We can provide "pen-test-2025.pdf" and SOC2 summary. Note: token-level export needs DPA signoff.

Jen (Legal): If they want subcontractor lists or content-level telemetry exported, we'll need a DPA addendum. Flagging retention request if they ask >180 days.

Liam (Solutions): Quick infra snippet for infra team:

```
deploy:
  mode: private
  region: eu-west-1
  nodes: 4
  kms: hsm-sim
  monitoring: prometheus
```

Sara (Sales): Actions: Liam -> final POC runbook + cost scenarios (reserved vs burst); Rebecca -> RFI attachments + answers; Jen -> DPA note; I'll bundle and send by Wednesday EOD.

infra-bot: Infra plan lint: OK for branch "cortica-rfp".

Priya (Cortica): Thanks — we'll review packet and propose POC kickoff dates after your packet.
